guestId.description: Logical reference to the guests schema.

sellableUnits.description: Optional and advisory (ADR-0006): ignored for the booking decision; the server derives the ceiling from the room inventory Rooms records. A malformed value is still VALIDATION_FAILED.

priceBasis.description: Advisory (ADR-0007): the server re-derives the frozen total and the applied discount name from Rates QuotePrice for this room type, dates, and discount. The asserted totalMinor never sets a stored value; a value that disagrees with the quote is refused PRICE_CHANGED (409). The field stays required for the deprecation window so the current desk build keeps working.

totalMinor.description: The total the caller shows; compared with the Rates quote, never stored (ADR-0007 D3).

discountName.description: Discount to quote with; the stored name is the one the quote applied (ADR-0007 D1).

errors.when: No sellable unit left for the type and dates; details name type+dates (NFR-CON-1).

The room inventory could not be read, so the booking was refused; details name upstream rooms and CheckRoomTypeSellability (ADR-0006 D4). The price could not be read either, so the booking is refused rather than frozen at an unverified total; details name upstream rates and QuotePrice (ADR-0007 D4).

The body's priceBasis.totalMinor differs from the Rates QuotePrice total for the room type, dates, and discount, so nothing was booked; details name roomTypeId, arrivalDate, departureDate, requestedTotalMinor, and quotedTotalMinor (ADR-0007 D3).
A stay restriction is violated; details name the restriction (FR-RTE-4).

Missing field, bad date order, or a hotel-mandatory guest field is missing (FR-CUS-1); the Rates quote may also refuse an unknown discount naming discountName or an ambiguous plan set naming ratePlanName, surfaced unchanged (ADR-0007 D4).

Unknown room type: Rooms refused the capacity read and the refusal is surfaced unchanged (ADR-0006 D4). Rates may also answer no_rate_price (a night has no price row) or no_rate_plan (no plan prices the type) and that refusal is surfaced unchanged too, storing nothing (ADR-0007 D4).
